info.name: cclu-api
info.description: Manual testing collection for the CCLU API. Every endpoint lives in the folder of the module that owns it. The collection stores no credentials: create a Postman environment of your own and set the variables this collection declares.

item.name: Health
item.description: Service and database reachability. Not part of the domain.

request.description: Returns 200 with "database": "connected" when the API reached MongoDB, and 503 with "database": "disconnected" when the process started but the connection is down.
Returns the identity behind the session cookie. Postman stores the cookie on sign in and sends it back on its own, so there is nothing to paste here.
Clears the session cookie. Needs no authentication, so an expired session can still be closed.
